name: AFFIN Bank Berhad
overview: AFFIN Bank 于2026年4月完成以5000万令吉现金收购 Pheim Asset Management Sdn Bhd 全部股权，后者成为其全资子公司，属于资产管理业务的扩张。其他公告主要为股息再投资计划、股东大会及季度业绩发布，未披露其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约事项。
overview_en: AFFIN Bank completed the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Pheim Asset Management Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM50.0 million in April 2026, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary, which represents an expansion in asset management. Other announcements mainly relate to the dividend reinvestment plan, general meetings and quarterly results, with no other expansion, reduction or contract matters disclosed for other business segments.

segments.name: 投资银行
segments.note: 今年完成收购 Pheim Asset Management，扩大资产管理业务。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of Pheim Asset Management this year, expanding asset management operations.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以5000万令吉现金完成收购 Pheim Asset Management Sdn Bhd 全部股权，后者成为全资子公司。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Pheim Asset Management Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM50.0 million, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 证券监督委员会于2026年4月13日批准 Pheim AM、Pheim Islamic AM 及 Pheim UT 的控制权变更。
actions.text_en: The Securities Commission approved the change in controller of Pheim AM, Pheim Islamic AM and Pheim UT on 13 April 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 国家银行于2026年4月2日批准收购 Pheim AM，附带完成后运营流程审查等条件。
actions.text_en: Bank Negara Malaysia approved the acquisition of Pheim AM on 2 April 2026, subject to conditions including post-completion reviews of certain operational processes.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 Pheim Asset Management 全部股权，将资产管理公司纳入为全资子公司。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Pheim Asset Management, the asset management company became a wholly-owned subsidiary.
